hook: Hide spiders face down as Lids, then watch them burst out mid-fight and strike before the enemy can react.
loop: Flip units face down as Lids and set each Lid's countdown.
Lids grow while hidden; knock sources tune when they spring.
Lids spring mid-fight, strike out of turn, and trigger spring payoffs.

growth.line: Flat permanent buffs to Lids each turn through Tier 4; Tiers 5-6 grow only inside fights.

feel.early: Small Lids hide and grow; a free first strike.
feel.mid: Knock sources and Retreats tune springs; Jill feeds Discovers.
feel.late: Spring chains buff everyone, or all Lids spring at once.

stars.why: Stabs the enemy across, hides after each kill, springs again.
Springs copies from your hand; ranked the seed's best card.
Each empty slot is a knock, or a missing unit.

card_short.u01: Lie in Wait 1; grows a little when it springs.
card_short.u02: Grows permanently each turn it ends as a Lid.
card_short.u03: Gives gold if it stayed hidden all last fight.
card_short.u04: Permanently buffs Lids next to it each turn.
card_short.u05: Knocks on your Lids whenever it attacks; never hides.
card_short.u06: Gives a unit Lie in Wait, or lowers its N.
card_short.u07: Knocks whenever an enemy attacks a unit next to it.
card_short.u08: Twice a fight, a springing unit gains permanent stats.
card_short.u09: Springs fast, gains stats, hides again once after attacking.
card_short.u10: Permanently buffs all your Lids each turn.
card_short.u11: Springs out Nieces as Lids; dying makes three more.
card_short.u12: Knocks once per empty slot at Start of Combat.
card_short.u13: After springing, Discover a non-Lodge unit with Lie in Wait.
card_short.u14: Hidden until last; while hidden, Spring effects trigger twice.
card_short.u15: Other Lie in Wait units hide again after first attack.
card_short.u16: Springs instantly, stabs across; hides again after each kill.
card_short.u17: While hidden, springs hand cards into dead units' slots.
card_short.u18: Each spring gives your other units +1/+1 for the fight.
card_short.u19: Lids grow each enemy attack; all spring when wall falls.
card_short.x02: No tribe spells; Harvest Supper still reaches Lids.
card_short.x04: Goldens keep N and limits unless their text says otherwise.

builds.name: The Busy Bank
builds.line: Knock sources and low-N Lids spring early and strike first.

builds.name: The Long Wait
builds.line: Hard face-up wall; Lids grow hidden, then all spring together.

builds.name: Strike and Hide
builds.line: Diadem and Corkhinge: spring, strike, retreat, spring again, doubled.

liked: Lids change who's hit, who attacks first and what scouting shows.
Setting each Lid's count against your knocks is a real drafting puzzle.
worries: Worshipful Master could hit +15/+15 with chained springs; unclear if Lids get it.
Watch Gossamer Jill's Discover every turn, and Long Wait's hero damage.
changed: Signora Corkhinge now springs only last, by the fallback; mass springs can't open her.
Grand Tyler now springs the leftmost hand card, and its Spring effect fires.
Golden Brother Atypus now retreats six times a fight, not stats only.
verdict: Ambush lovers hide spiders face down, time each Lid's countdown, and spring them mid-fight before enemies react.
